main.description: A reader's relation to one catalog edition, published from the copy they are holding. Two shapes share this collection: a position record (one per edition and format, its rkey the edition's rkey and the format's slug, rewritten as the reader moves) and an annotation record (one per note, under a TID, rewritten when the note is edited). `createdAt` is when the record was first published — the position's first save, the note's own creation — and `updatedAt` when it last changed. Written by Livtet in the reader's own repo and indexed by the catalog.

format.description: The reader's format name as the app's seeded formats table spells it (`Hardcover`, `ePub`, `Audiobook`). It is the reader's own copy, not the edition's merged medium: two readers of one edition can report a print and an audio position against it.

identifier.description: The product identifier this position's `total` came from; absent when the total came from the edition record.

position.description: The reading position. Present on a position record, absent on an annotation record.

annotation.description: The note this record mirrors. A record carries either a `position` or an `annotation`; the rkey is a TID, so a note's record is found through the reader's own database rather than derived.

createdAt.description: When this record was first published.

updatedAt.description: When the reader last moved to this position, or last edited this note.

identifier.description: The catalog identifier a total belongs to, such as the print ISBN-13 whose page count `position.total` holds. The edition record's own page count and duration are separate rank winners over these claims, so without this a consumer cannot tell which product a total describes.

issuer.description: The identifier's issuing scheme, as the catalog spells it (`isbn13`, `isbn10`, `asin`).

position.description: The position, on the unit's own scale. `per_mille` is tenths of a percent (0–1000); `page` and `virtual_page` are counts; `timestamp` is seconds; `chapter` is the whole chapter number, with any fraction in `locator`; `cfi` is not a scale, so the CFI rides in `locator` and `value` is 0.

value.description: The position in `unit`. Only `per_mille` has a fixed range (0–1000).

total.description: The whole in the same unit: a page count (`identifier`'s claim), a chapter count (the edition's), or a duration in seconds (the audio claim's). Absent when no extent is known.

locator.description: The precise position the integer rounds off: an EPUB CFI, a printed page label, or a clock time.

annotation.description: One note taken while reading, mirrored from the reader's own database. `id` is the note's id there, so an edit rewrites the same record instead of appending one.

id.description: The note's id in the reader's database.

locator.description: Where in the copy the note sits: a printed page, a chapter, a CFI.

quote.description: The passage the note is attached to.

color.description: The highlight colour, as the reader's app spells it.
